explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/877: with f_m(n) the number of maximal sum-free subsets of {1,…,n}, is f_m(n) = o(2^{n/2})? Yes (Łuczak–Schoen). fm counts subsets of [1,n] that are sum-free (IsSumFree) and maximal among sum-free subsets of [1,n]. The statement is fm = o(2^{n/2}). Faithful.
